summary: Ukrainian forces struck four Russian naval vessels in Novorossiysk, including two frigates and a missile ship. Russia has accumulated approximately 6,200 kamikaze drones for attacks on Ukraine. Zelenskyy urged Western partners to intensify peace efforts and warned of potential Russian expansion into NATO territories.
key_points: Ukrainian forces destroyed four Russian naval vessels in Novorossiysk, including two frigates (Admiral Makarov and Admiral Essen), a missile ship (Byak-M), and a patrol boat (Vasyl Bikov) (Source: @UkraineNow/83388).
Russia has accumulated approximately 6,200 kamikaze drones for attacks on Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/83392).
Zelenskyy stated Ukraine needs 5-10% of U.S. Patriot missile supplies to survive winter and destroy all Russian ballistic missiles (Source: @UkraineNow/83393).
Ukrainian forces conducted a unique operation against Russia's main Black Sea Fleet base in Novorossiysk (Source: @UkraineNow/83392).
Ukrainian cities face winter survival risks with no backup relocation options (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32429).
Russia prepared captured Ukrainians for exchanges, improving their physical condition before repatriation (Source: @UkraineNow/83400).
Ukrainian railways evacuated 340 passengers and a train crew after a drone attack on Odesa railway (Source: @UkraineNow/83396).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's accumulation of 6,200 kamikaze drones poses a severe threat to Ukrainian infrastructure and civilian populations. Ukrainian forces' destruction of four Russian naval vessels in Novorossiysk represents a significant operational success but may escalate Russian retaliation. Zelenskyy's warnings about potential Russian expansion into NATO territories indicate heightened strategic risks for regional stability.
sections.regional_response: Japan condemned Putin's visit to the disputed Iturup island, with Japanese Foreign Minister Yevgeny Motegi emphasizing territorial claims. The Czech Republic implemented new rules denying temporary protection to Ukrainian men unable to prove military service fulfillment, affecting refugee processing. NATO allies face pressure to increase military aid to Ukraine amid Russian drone buildup and potential escalation risks.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian forces demonstrated advanced operational capabilities with the Novorossiysk naval strike, potentially disrupting Russian Black Sea Fleet logistics. Russia's drone accumulation suggests a focus on asymmetric warfare against Ukrainian infrastructure. Zelenskyy's appeals for Western military support highlight Ukraine's urgent defense needs. The body exchange of 261 Russian and 24 Ukrainian casualties indicates ongoing prisoner negotiations. Winter humanitarian risks in Ukraine underscore the need for accelerated international assistance.
